question: Should assistant-message plain-text copy be implemented as an inline Markdown/plain-text copy menu, a persisted default-copy-format preference, or a smaller one-shot plain-text action?
rationale: The code boundary is narrow, but the issue proposes multiple UX shapes and the conversion contract affects how users expect code blocks, links, tables, lists, and hidden thinking text to paste.

options.title: Copy Menu
options.body: Add a compact menu or split action with Copy as Markdown and Copy as Plain Text, leaving any default-format preference for a later product decision.

options.title: Persisted Preference
options.body: Add a default copy-format preference and keep the message copy button as one action, accepting the extra settings, persistence, and i18n surface.

options.title: Decline Core Change
options.body: Keep Markdown-only copy behavior if maintainers decide plain-text clipboard formatting is not worth the Control UI surface.

recommendation.title: Copy Menu
recommendation.body: Add a compact menu or split action with Copy as Markdown and Copy as Plain Text, leaving any default-format preference for a later product decision.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the original copy-as-markdown behavior and have recent adjacent Control UI chat ownership signals.
